create_uva_buffer_pool: create a UVA buffer pool with round-robin concurrency for CPU-to-GPU data transfers using unified virtual addressing
test_uva_backed_tensor: test the UvaBackedTensor class that provides a CPU-backed tensor with UVA buffer pool for concurrent GPU access
